Guava pastelitos.d: Puff pastry sealed around guava paste and cream cheese, brushed with sugar syrup.
Guava pastelitos.note: Out of the oven every hour till close.

Gold token cookies.d: Butter shortbread the size of a fare, punched through the middle, brushed with gold.
Gold token cookies.note: Good for a cookie. Not a ride.

Arroz con pollo.d: Thighs browned hard, then set on long-grain rice cooked slow with onion, green pepper, garlic, cilantro, achiote, green olives and capers.

Token booth honey roasted nuts.d: Almonds, cashews and peanuts baked with honey, sugar, cinnamon and salt, stirred till glossy. Warm in a paper cone.

Money Train payday michelada.d: Cold lager over ice, fresh lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and Worcestershire, chili salt rim.
